p.src: We shall leave the Great Sage resting while the heavenly gods kept him surrounded. Our tale now turns to Guanyin, the Greatly Compassionate and Greatly Merciful Bodhisattva of Inspired Response, Savior from Suffering and Calamity, of Mount Potalaka in the Southern Sea. Invited by the Queen Mother to attend the Peach Banquet, she ascended with her chief disciple, the pilgrim Hui'an, to the jeweled pavilion by the Jasper Pool, only to find the place desolate and the banquet tables in disarray. Though several celestial immortals were present, none had taken a seat; all were talking together in great confusion. After the Bodhisattva had exchanged greetings with them, the immortals told her all that had happened. The Bodhisattva said, “Since there is neither a grand feast nor any passing of the wine cup, you may all come with me to see the Jade Emperor.” The immortals gladly followed her. When they reached the Hall of Perfect Light, they found the Four Great Celestial Masters, the Barefoot Immortal, and many others already assembled there. They came forward to greet the Bodhisattva and told her that the Jade Emperor was distressed, that he had dispatched the heavenly troops, and that they had not yet returned from capturing the monster. The Bodhisattva said, “I wish to see the Jade Emperor. Please announce me.” The Celestial Master Qiu Hongji immediately entered the Hall of Miraculous Mists, reported her arrival, and received orders to admit her. At that time the Supreme Lord Laozi was in attendance at the front, and the Queen Mother was seated behind.

The moment he was born, golden light flashed from his eyes and shot as far as the Palace of the Dipper. At first we paid him no heed, but later he became a spirit, subdued dragons and tigers, and struck his own name from the register of death. The Dragon Kings and the Kings of Hell then submitted memorials against him. We intended to have him arrested, but the Star of Longevity memorialized: ‘Among the creatures of the Three Realms, any being with nine apertures may attain immortality.’ We therefore resolved to educate and employ the worthy, summoned him to Heaven, and appointed him Protector of the Horses in the Imperial Stables. p.src: The pilgrim Hui'an straightened his robes, took up an iron staff, mounted a cloud, and left the celestial court, heading directly for the mountain. He saw the heavenly net spread layer upon layer, while sentries at every camp gate rang bells and called out passwords; the mountain was surrounded so tightly that not even water could pass through. Hui'an halted and called, “Heavenly soldiers guarding the camp gate, please report my arrival. I am Muzha, the second son of Heavenly King Li—Guanyin of the Southern Sea’s chief disciple, Hui'an—and I have come especially to learn the state of the battle.” The divine troops of the Five Sacred Peaks in the camp immediately passed the message through the main gate. The Rat of the Void, Rooster of the Hairy Head, Horse of the Star, and Hare of the Room relayed it to the central command tent. Heavenly King Li sent out a command flag, ordering the heavenly net opened so that Hui'an could enter. By then the eastern sky was just beginning to brighten. Hui'an followed the command flag inside and bowed before the Four Great Heavenly Kings and Heavenly King Li. After he had bowed, Heavenly King Li asked, “My son, where have you come from?” Hui'an replied, “Your unworthy son accompanied the Bodhisattva to the Peach Banquet. When she saw the splendid feast laid waste and the Jasper Pool deserted, she led the assembled immortals and me to see the Jade Emperor. The Jade Emperor explained that Father and the others had descended to subdue the monster monkey, but that no report had come for a whole day and the outcome was unknown. The Bodhisattva therefore ordered me here to discover the truth.” Heavenly King Li said, “We arrived yesterday and pitched camp. We sent the Nine Luminaries to challenge him, but the wretch displayed tremendous magic and drove all nine of them back in defeat. Then we personally led out the troops, and the wretch also drew up his forces for battle. Our hundred thousand heavenly soldiers fought him in a confused melee until evening, when he used a body-multiplying spell to drive us back. When we withdrew and counted our captives, we had taken only wolves, insects, tigers, leopards, and the like—not so much as half a monster monkey. We have not yet gone out to battle today.”

Do you not recognize me? I am Erlang, nephew of the Jade Emperor, imperially enfeoffed as King of Illustrious Grace and Divine Manifestation. By command from above, I have come to capture you, rebellious stable-groom baboon who has risen against the Celestial Palace. Yet still you know nothing of life or death!” The Great Sage said, “I recall that years ago the Jade Emperor’s younger sister longed for the mortal world, descended below, and married Lord Yang. She bore a son who once split Peach Mountain with an axe. Would that be you? I ought to curse you a few times, but unfortunately there is no great grievance between us. I might strike you with my staff, but it would be a pity to take your life. You are merely a young lordling. Hurry back and summon the Four Great Heavenly Kings to face me.” Hearing this, the True Lord flew into a rage and cried, “Impudent monkey! p.src: The True Lord and the Great Sage fought for more than three hundred rounds, with neither victory nor defeat decided. The True Lord summoned all his divine might, shook himself, and transformed into a figure ten thousand fathoms tall. In both hands he raised his sacred three-pointed, double-edged blade. He looked like a peak rising from the summit of Mount Hua, with a blue face, jutting fangs, and crimson hair; savage and fearsome, he brought the weapon down upon the Great Sage’s head. The Great Sage also exercised his magic and transformed until his body was the same size as Erlang’s and his features equally fearsome. He raised his compliant golden-hooped staff, now like the pillar that upholds Heaven atop Mount Kunlun, and blocked the God Erlang. The sight terrified Marshals Ma and Liu so badly that they trembled and could no longer wave their banners. Generals Beng and Ba quailed in fear and could no longer wield their swords. On the battlefield, Kang, Zhang, Yao, Li, Guo Shen, and Zhi Jian passed down their orders and unleashed the independent deities. Outside the Water Curtain Cave, they set loose the hawks and hounds, loaded their crossbows, drew their bows, and charged in together for the slaughter. Alas, they scattered the demon monkeys’ four valiant commanders and captured two or three thousand creatures and spirits. The monkeys threw down their spears and cast off their armor, abandoned swords and discarded lances. Some fled, some shouted; some scrambled up the mountain, while others returned to the cave. They were like roosting birds startled by an owl at night, scattering like stars across the sky. The brothers won the victory; of that we shall say no more.

p.src: Amid the uproar, the True Lord arrived and asked, “Brothers, where did you lose sight of him?” The gods replied, “We had him surrounded right here, and then he vanished.” Erlang opened his phoenix eyes wide and looked about. He saw that the Great Sage had changed into a sparrow and was perched upon a tree. He withdrew his colossal form, cast aside his divine weapon, and took down his pellet bow. Then, with a shake of his body, he changed into a sparrow hawk, spread his wings, and flew at him. Seeing this, the Great Sage took wing with a whir, changed into a great cormorant, and soared into the sky. At the sight, Erlang swiftly shook out his plumage, transformed himself into a great sea crane, and shot through the clouds to seize him in his beak. The Great Sage plunged down again into the ravine, changed into a fish, and slipped into the water. Erlang reached the edge of the ravine but found no trace of him. He thought to himself, “That macaque must have gone into the water and changed into some kind of fish or shrimp. Let me transform again and catch him.” Sure enough, he changed into a fish hawk and hovered over the surface downstream, waiting for a while. The Great Sage, in the form of a fish, was swimming with the current when he suddenly saw a bird: it resembled a blue hawk, yet its feathers were not blue; it resembled an egret, yet had no crest upon its head; it resembled a stork, yet its legs were not red. “That must be Erlang transformed and waiting for me!” He quickly turned and darted away with a splash. Erlang saw him and thought, “That fish which splashed and turned away resembles a carp, yet its tail is not red; it resembles a mandarin fish, yet has no patterned scales; it resembles a snakehead, yet bears no star upon its head; it resembles a bream, yet has no barb by its gills. Why did it turn back the moment it saw me? It must be that monkey in disguise.” He swept after him and stabbed once with his beak. The Great Sage leapt from the water and changed into a water snake, which swam close to the bank and burrowed into the grass. Erlang had failed to catch him in his beak, but amid the splashing he saw a snake dart from the water and recognized it as the Great Sage. He wheeled about at once and changed into a grey crane with an embroidered crimson crown. Stretching out a long beak like a pair of pointed iron pincers, he came straight to devour the water snake. The water snake gave a leap and changed again, this time into a bustard. Dull and ungainly, it stood upon a bank overgrown with knotgrass. Erlang saw that he had changed into so base a creature—the bustard being held the basest and most wanton of birds, mating indiscriminately with luan, phoenix, hawk, and crow alike—and therefore would not approach him. Instead, he resumed his true form, strode forward, took up his pellet bow, drew it to the full, and struck him with a pellet so that he stumbled headlong.

p.src: Seizing the opportunity, the Great Sage rolled down the cliff, crouched there, and transformed himself again, this time into a local earth-god shrine. His mouth gaped wide to form its entrance; his teeth became the doors; his tongue became the bodhisattva image; and his eyes became the latticed windows; only his tail was difficult to conceal, so he stuck it up behind the shrine and made it into a flagpole. The True Lord reached the foot of the cliff. The bustard he had knocked down was nowhere to be seen; there was only a little shrine. He quickly opened his phoenix eyes and examined it closely. Seeing the flagpole standing behind it, he laughed and said, “It is that macaque! Once again he is trying to fool me. I have seen many temples, but never one with its flagpole standing behind it. This is certainly that beast’s trickery. If he tricks me into entering, he will snap me up in one bite. Why would I go inside? I will first smash the latticed windows with my fists, then kick down the doors.” Hearing this, the Great Sage was alarmed and thought, “How vicious! How vicious! The doors are my teeth and the windows are my eyes. If he knocks out my teeth and smashes my eyes, what shall I do?” With a sudden tiger-like bound, he sprang into the air and disappeared once more.

p.src: The True Lord chased wildly back and forth. Presently the four Commandants and two Generals crowded around him and asked, “Elder brother, have you captured the Great Sage?” The True Lord laughed and said, “That monkey just now changed himself into a shrine to deceive me. Just as I was about to smash his windows and kick down his doors, he gave a leap and vanished without a trace again. Most extraordinary! Most extraordinary!” They were all astonished and looked in every direction, but saw no sign or shadow of him. The True Lord said, “Brothers, stand guard and patrol here while I go up to search for him.” He sprang up at once, mounted a cloud, and rose into midair. There he saw Heavenly King Li holding the demon-revealing mirror aloft and standing with Nezha upon the clouds. The True Lord asked, “Heavenly King, have you seen the Monkey King?” The Heavenly King replied, “He has not come up here. I have been keeping him under observation from this place.” The True Lord recounted the whole affair: their contest of transformations, their displays of magic, and the capture of the monkey host. Then he added, “He changed into a shrine and escaped just as I was about to strike him.” Hearing this, Heavenly King Li swept the demon-revealing mirror in every direction once more. He laughed aloud and said, “True Lord, go quickly! Go quickly! That monkey used an invisibility spell, slipped through the encirclement, and has gone to your home at the Guankou of the Guan River.” On hearing this, Erlang immediately took up his divine weapon and hurried back in pursuit toward the Guankou of the Guan River.

p.src: Meanwhile, the Great Sage had already reached the Guankou of the Guan River. With a shake of his body, he assumed the likeness of Lord Erlang, lowered his cloud, and went straight into the temple. The ghostly judges could not tell the difference and kowtowed one after another to welcome him. He sat in the central seat and inspected the offerings: the three sacrificial animals Li Hu had presented in fulfillment of a vow; Zhang Long’s promised offering for blessings; Zhao Jia’s petition for a son; and Qian Bing’s earnest vow concerning his illness. While he was examining them, someone reported, “Another lord has arrived.” The ghostly judges hurried to look, and every one of them was struck with alarm. The True Lord asked, “Has some fellow called the Great Sage Equal to Heaven just come here?” The ghostly judges replied, “We have seen no Great Sage. There is only another lord inside inspecting the offerings.” The True Lord burst through the door. Seeing him, the Great Sage resumed his true appearance and said, “Young lord, there is no need to make a clamor. This temple now belongs to the house of Sun.” The True Lord immediately raised his divine three-pointed, double-edged blade and slashed straight at his face. With a deft movement, the Monkey King evaded the divine blade. He pulled out the embroidery needle, shook it once until it became as thick as a rice bowl, rushed forward, and met his opponent face-to-face. Shouting and clamoring, the two fought their way out through the temple gate. Half in mist and half in cloud, they battled as they traveled, until they fought their way back to the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. This so alarmed the Four Great Heavenly Kings and the others that they tightened their defenses still further. Commandants Kang and Zhang and the others came forward to meet the True Lord. Joining hearts and strength with him, they surrounded the Handsome Monkey King. Of this, no more need be said for now.

p.src: Now, after the Mighty-Spirit Demon King had summoned the True Lord and his six brothers to lead their troops against the fiend, he returned to the celestial court to report. The Jade Emperor, Guanyin Bodhisattva, the Queen Mother, and the assembled immortals were conversing in the Hall of Miraculous Mist. p.src: The Bodhisattva addressed Laozi: “What do you think of the Erlang God whom I recommended? He truly possesses great divine powers. He has already hemmed in the Great Sage, though he has yet to capture him. I shall now lend him a hand and make certain that the ape is caught.” Laozi said, “What weapon will you use, Bodhisattva? How do you intend to help him?” The Bodhisattva replied, “I shall cast down my willow sprig and pure vase to strike that monkey’s head. Even if it does not kill him, it will at least knock him over, allowing Little Sage Erlang to seize him.” Laozi said, “That vase of yours is porcelain. It would be well if it struck him, but if it missed his head and happened to collide with his iron staff, would it not shatter? Hold your hand for the moment, and let me lend him some aid.” The Bodhisattva asked, “What weapon do you have?” Laozi replied, “I have one, indeed I have.” Rolling up his sleeve, he removed a circlet from his left arm and said, “This weapon was forged from kun-steel and perfected by a touch of my reverted elixir. Nourished until it acquired a body full of numinous power, it can transform at will, is proof against both water and fire, and can also snare all manner of things. It is called the ‘Diamond Jade Bangle,’ and also the ‘Diamond Snare.’ In former years, when I passed through Hangu Pass and converted the barbarians, turning them toward Buddhism, I relied greatly upon it. It is the finest protection at all times. Let me throw it down and strike him with it.”

Below, the Four Great Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, and the other gods withdrew their troops and struck camp. They came forward to congratulate the Little Sage, all saying, “This achievement belongs to the Little Sage.” The Little Sage replied, “This was due to the Heavenly Venerable’s abundant blessing and the divine authority of all the gods. What credit can I claim?” Kang, Zhang, Yao, and Li said, “Elder Brother, there is no need for further ceremony. Let us escort this wretch to the upper realm, present him before the Jade Emperor, and request an edict for his punishment.” The True Lord said, “Worthy brothers, none of you have received celestial registers, so you may not appear before the Jade Emperor. Have the celestial armored troops escort him, while I go with the Heavenly Kings to the upper realm and report the fulfillment of the edict. You are to lead the forces in searching this mountain, and once it has been thoroughly cleared, return to Guankou. When I have requested our rewards and secured recognition of our merits, I shall return and celebrate with you.” The four marshals and two generals accepted his orders and assented. The True Lord and the others then mounted the clouds, singing songs of triumph as they returned victorious to the celestial court. Before long, they arrived outside the Hall of Complete Illumination. u.src: Laozi retrieved the Diamond Jade Bangle and invited the Jade Emperor, Guanyin, the Queen Mother, and all the immortals to return to the Hall of Miraculous Mist.

Below, the Four Great Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, and the other gods withdrew their troops and struck camp. They came forward to congratulate the Little Sage, all saying, “This achievement belongs to the Little Sage.”
The Little Sage replied, “This was due to the Heavenly Venerable’s abundant blessing and the divine authority of all the gods. What credit can I claim?”

Kang, Zhang, Yao, and Li said, “Elder Brother, there is no need for further ceremony. Let us escort this wretch to the upper realm, present him before the Jade Emperor, and request an edict for his punishment.”
The True Lord said, “Worthy brothers, none of you have received celestial registers, so you may not appear before the Jade Emperor.
Have the celestial armored troops escort him, while I go with the Heavenly Kings to the upper realm and report the fulfillment of the edict.
You are to lead the forces in searching this mountain, and once it has been thoroughly cleared, return to Guankou.
When I have requested our rewards and secured recognition of our merits, I shall return and celebrate with you.”
The four marshals and two generals accepted his orders and assented.
The True Lord and the others then mounted the clouds, singing songs of triumph as they returned victorious to the celestial court.
Before long, they arrived outside the Hall of Complete Illumination.
The Celestial Master memorialized the throne: “The Four Great Heavenly Kings and the others have captured the demon monkey, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and now await the imperial summons.”
The Jade Emperor issued an edict at once, ordering the Mighty-Spirit Demon King and the celestial guards to take the wretch to the Demon-Beheading Terrace and hack his body to pieces.
Ah!
Indeed:
